review_scope: Read-only audit of the frozen fused-interpolation timing evidence and acceptance decision.

reasons: Both independent runs exceed the registered primary 15-cell geometric-mean limit of 0.98.
Run 2 exceeds the registered all-86-cell worst-ratio limit of 1.05.
Nine of 71 baseline control cells exceed the registered per-cell run2/run1 drift interval.
The approved timing-attempt-02 output directory is empty; the runner wrote data to its sibling timing directory.
The independent static review receipt does not attest that its runtime was Astra Max.

build_identity.validation: The read-only summarizer accepted the externally anchored build digest and validated both runs against the same source, producer, tool, library, GMP, binary, and input identities.

timing_recomputation.method: Reran experiments/fused-interpolation-20261108/summarize.py against the existing raw files, with no benchmark, calibration, proof, or build invocation.
timing_recomputation.raw_validation: Both runs pass exact cell order, argv binding, stdout payload binding, counts, and raw median/ratio recomputation.

protocol_deviation.evidence: root-protocol-review.json records output_directory=timing-attempt-02; run_fused_timing.ps1 sets runRoot to timing-attempt-02 but sets run1, run2, and summary paths under timing/.
protocol_deviation.consequence: Raw measurements remain structurally valid and identity-bound, but the execution does not satisfy the specifically approved output-location provenance. Preserve the data as NO-GO evidence; do not claim exact path compliance or erase the discrepancy. This deviation does not explain or reverse the numeric failures.

host_receipts.machine: AMD Ryzen 7 7745HX, Windows 11, WSL2 kernel 6.6.87.2-microsoft-standard-WSL2, Rust 1.99.1, Python 3.12.3
host_receipts.interpretation: Host counters and load are retained as observations. No post hoc host exclusion was applied; the reported numerical failures remain included.

independent_review.identity_caveat: The receipt names an independent Astra Max requested role and gpt-6-astra/max dispatch, but also says its runtime identity was Codex GPT-6 and was not identified as Astra Max. Preserve that caveat; this audit does not treat the Astra Max review requirement as independently established.

claim_limits: The static package reports 369 candidate verification items, 4,036 independent integer-oracle fixtures per producer, and semantic-mutation rejection; those are static/correctness claims only.
The measured candidate result is a NO-GO on the frozen inputs, binaries, and host. It does not establish universal GMP parity or solver parity.
No candidate enablement, merge, production performance acceptance, or GMP parity claim is justified.
